array.string: dev=$(/usr/sbin/networksetup -listnetworkserviceorder | /usr/bin/awk '/^\([0-9]+\) Wi-Fi/{getline; gsub(/\)/,"",$NF); print $NF; exit}'); [ -z "$dev" ] && dev=en1; /usr/bin/open -a HeliPort; i=0; while [ $i -lt 45 ]; do if /sbin/ifconfig "$dev" 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -q "inet "; then sleep 5; /usr/bin/pkill -x HeliPort; exit 0; fi; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done; exit 1
